description.narrative: Empowering Mozambicans to protect their future/Sustainable Seas and Communities in Mozambique is the programme for this year 200,000EUR grant, refocused the conservation efforts to ensure that resources are being directed towards objectives that lie within our adjusted funding restraints and expertise, reducing the pressure on the community and team and instead focussing more on advocacy, community policing, livelihoods and adult education and expects to reach these outcomes: A network of passionate and influential Ocean Ambassadors; a generation of Ocean Guardians, who understand and cherish the ocean; Increased national research capacity; Enhanced capacity to monitor and enforce protected areas; Alternative livelihoods for fishers (and potential future fishers) to reduce their reliance on destructive fishing methods; Empowering communities for sustainable progress. - MMF refocused the conservation efforts to ensure that resources are being directed towards objectives that lie within our adjusted funding restraints and expertise, reducing the pressure on the community and team and instead focussing more on advocacy, community policing, livelihoods and adult education.
